scope.reason: The resolver and its outbound side effect are extracted; nested Nest guards and permission checks make this a difficult precision case.

label.criterion: A billing checkout creation is safe for the tested unauthorized-action property when workspace, user and no-permission guards all precede the action and the service rechecks workspace permissions.
label.why: checkoutSession has WorkspaceAuthGuard, UserAuthGuard and NoPermissionGuard, then calls validateCanCheckoutSessionPermissionOrThrow before requesting a checkout URL.
